note: Yellowstone NP campground in lodgepole pine a short walk from the southeast shore of Lewis Lake, on the road between the South Entrance and West Thumb; boat ramp by the registration area. Generators are not allowed. A 23-ft rig fits only a handful of the longest sites. --Claude
summary: NPS-run, rec.gov 259309 (stored no link): 84 sites all reservable (80% at 6 months, 20% at 2 weeks), $20 2027, strict 25-ft total vehicle limit with only 5 RV sites at 24-25 ft, no generators, vault toilets, water Jul 1-Oct 1, season Jun 15-Oct 10 2027. Not waterfront kept (nearest sites ~70 m from the shore in forest). Pin ~190 m - no move.
flags: RIG FIT (not a drop, reviewer may judge): campground-wide 'total vehicle length limit ... 25 feet (7.6 m) and is strictly enforced'. On recreation.gov's catalog only 5 sites accept an RV at 23 ft or more: 20 and 21 (25 ft), 38 and 44 (24 ft), 82 (25 ft); sites 34, 42 and 58 permit an RV with no stated RV length on 23-25 ft pads. Most others are 12-22 ft. A 23-ft rig fits, but booking needs one of those few sites.
